What factor of a wetland affects migratory birds? and if the factor changes in the future, how will behaviour change?

Every downstream step (stationary distribution with parameter-uncertainty intervals, simulated
trajectories, bout lengths, energy budget) is run for each SSP in `ssp_files` and compared
against the same historical baseline.

```{r load package, message=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ranger)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(momentuHMM)
```

```{r}
scaling_ref <- readRDS("/Users/yjkang/Desktop/NIE_BigData/HMM_scaling_ref.rds")
z_ref <- function(x, var) (x - scaling_ref[[paste0(var, "_mu")]]) / scaling_ref[[paste0(var, "_sd")]]

# Safety check: the reference must reproduce the Z-scores stored in the fitted model.
# If this fails, the .rds files come from different runs of 04.
ref_check <- hmm_model$data %>% filter(In_Hangang == 1)
for (v in c("Temp", "Wind", "wTemp", "BOD", "Chlor", "DTN", "SPI6")) {
  ok <- !is.na(ref_check[[v]])
  stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(z_ref(ref_check[[v]][ok], v),
                             ref_check[[paste0("Z_", v)]][ok], tolerance = 1e-8)))
}
```

```{r scenario setup}
shift_years <- function(t) t + years(horizon)   # 29 Feb -> NA when the target year isn't a leap year
```

```{r}
# map future data & normalise with the historical mean/SD
prep_future_covs <- function(path) {
  read.csv(path) %>%
    mutate(
      Date_Time = as.POSIXct(Date_Time, format="%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", tz="UTC"),
      In_Hangang = 1,
      Han_Temp   = z_ref(Temperature.C.,   "Temp"),
      Han_Wind   = z_ref(Wind_Speed.m.s.,  "Wind"),
      Han_SPI6   = z_ref(SPI6_Smooth,      "SPI6"),
      Han_wTemp  = z_ref(Pred_Water_Temp,  "wTemp"),
      Han_BOD    = z_ref(Pred_BOD,         "BOD"),
      Han_DTN    = z_ref(Pred_DTN,         "DTN"),
      Han_Chlor  = z_ref(Pred_Chlorophyll, "Chlor")
    ) %>%
    filter(month(with_tz(Date_Time, "Asia/Seoul")) %in% c(10, 11, 12, 1, 2, 3, 4)) %>%
    select(Station, Date_Time, In_Hangang, Han_Temp, Han_Wind,
           Han_wTemp, Han_BOD, Han_Chlor, Han_DTN, Han_SPI6) %>%
    na.omit()
}
future_covs_list <- lapply(ssp_files, prep_future_covs)   # named list: one data frame per SSP

# Projected shift of each covariate, in historical SD units (0 = no change from the fitted data)
bind_rows(future_covs_list, .id = "Scenario") %>%
  group_by(Scenario) %>%
  summarise(across(starts_with("Han_"), list(mean = mean, sd = sd)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(-Scenario, names_to = c("Covariate", ".value"), names_pattern = "(.*)_(mean|sd)$") %>%
  arrange(Covariate, Scenario) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

=======================================
Stationary distribution: historical vs future
=======================================
: the long-term expected proportion of time in State 1, 2, or 3 given a specific environment.
For every hourly step, the transition matrix is built from the fitted $\beta$ coefficients and its
stationary distribution is computed; these are averaged within each KST day, then over days.
B coefficient sets are drawn from the MLE's sampling distribution, beta ~ MVN(beta_hat, Sigma), 
and every period is evaluated with the same draw.
```{r stationary helpers}
# States: 1 = Traveling, 2 = Foraging, 3 = Roosting
stationary_3state <- function(X, beta) {
  e  <- exp(X %*% beta)
  s1 <- 1 + e[, 1] + e[, 2]
  s2 <- 1 + e[, 3] + e[, 4]
  s3 <- 1 + e[, 5] + e[, 6]
  g12 <- e[, 1] / s1; g13 <- e[, 2] / s1
  g21 <- e[, 3] / s2; g23 <- e[, 4] / s2
  g31 <- e[, 5] / s3; g32 <- e[, 6] / s3
  P <- cbind(Traveling = g21 * g31 + g23 * g31 + g32 * g21,
             Foraging  = g12 * g32 + g13 * g32 + g31 * g12,
             Roosting  = g13 * g23 + g12 * g23 + g21 * g13)
  P <- P / rowSums(P)
  if (any(!is.finite(P))) stop("Non-finite stationary probabilities (exp overflow in a draw?)")
  P
}

# Design matrix with exactly the columns (and order) of beta
make_X <- function(data, formula, beta) {
  X <- model.matrix(formula, data = data)
  if (nrow(X) != nrow(data)) stop("model.matrix() dropped rows with NA covariates")
  missing_cols <- setdiff(rownames(beta), colnames(X))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    message("Filling missing columns with 0: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
    X <- cbind(X, matrix(0, nrow(X), length(missing_cols),
                         dimnames = list(NULL, missing_cols)))
  }
  extra_cols <- setdiff(colnames(X), rownames(beta))
  if (length(extra_cols) > 0)
    message("Ignoring extra columns: ", paste(extra_cols, collapse = ", "))
  X[, rownames(beta), drop = FALSE]
}

# A period = design matrix + grouping of its rows into KST calendar days
make_period <- function(X, time) {
  f <- factor(as.Date(time, tz = "Asia/Seoul"))
  g <- as.integer(f)
  list(X = X, g = g, n = tabulate(g), days = as.Date(levels(f)))
}

# Period mean = mean of daily means (each day weighted equally)
period_means <- function(d, beta) {
  colMeans(rowsum(stationary_3state(d$X, beta), d$g) / d$n)
}

# Daily series in long format (for plots)
daily_series <- function(d, beta, label) {
  as.data.frame(rowsum(stationary_3state(d$X, beta), d$g) / d$n) %>%
    mutate(Date = d$days, Period = label) %>%
    pivot_longer(all_of(behav_levels), names_to = "Behavior", values_to = "Probability")
}

q <- function(x, p) unname(quantile(x, p))
```

```{r stationary periods}
beta_coeffs <- hmm_model$mle$beta 
cov_formula <- ~ Han_Temp + Han_Wind + Han_wTemp + Han_BOD + Han_Chlor + Han_DTN + Han_SPI6

# Historical covariates of the fitted HMM data
hist_hangang_data <- hmm_model$data #%>% filter(In_Hangang == 1)

# Future data matched to historical dates
match_date_df <- hmm_model$data %>%
  mutate(match_key = shift_years(roundT)) %>%
  select(Station, roundT, match_key)

# Steps with no calendar counterpart (29 Feb when roundT + horizon isn't a leap year)
n_no_key <- sum(is.na(match_date_df$match_key))
if (n_no_key > 0)
  message(n_no_key, " historical steps (29 Feb) have no date ", horizon,
          " years later; they are dropped from every future period")

# Shifted historical dates must fall inside the future covariate files
cov_range <- range(do.call(c, lapply(future_covs_list, function(d) range(d$Date_Time))))
key_range <- range(match_date_df$match_key, na.rm = TRUE)
if (key_range[1] < cov_range[1] || key_range[2] > cov_range[2])
  warning("Shifted historical dates (", format(key_range[1]), " to ", format(key_range[2]),
          " UTC) extend beyond the future covariates (", format(cov_range[1]), " to ",
          format(cov_range[2]), " UTC); steps outside are dropped")

prep_future_period <- function(fc, scenario) {
  mf <- match_date_df %>%
    left_join(fc %>% mutate(match_key = as.POSIXct(Date_Time)),
              by = c("match_key", "Station")) %>%
    select(-roundT, -match_key)
  n_before <- nrow(mf)
  mf <- mf %>% drop_na(Date_Time, starts_with("Han_"))
  if (nrow(mf) < n_before)
    message(scenario, ": ", n_before - nrow(mf), " of ", n_before,
            " historical steps without a future match dropped")
  make_period(make_X(mf, cov_formula, beta_coeffs), mf$Date_Time)
}

period_list <- c(
  setNames(list(make_period(make_X(hist_hangang_data, hmm_model$conditions$formula, beta_coeffs),
                            hist_hangang_data$time)), hist_label),
  setNames(lapply(scenarios, function(s) prep_future_period(future_covs_list[[s]], s)), scenarios))

# Covariate shift over the matched window only (historical SD units)
bind_rows(lapply(scenarios, function(s)
  as.data.frame(period_list[[s]]$X) %>% mutate(Scenario = s))) %>%
  group_by(Scenario) %>%
  summarise(across(starts_with("Han_"), mean), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(-Scenario, names_to = "Covariate", values_to = "Mean_shift_SD") %>%
  arrange(Covariate, Scenario) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r coefficient draws}
B_draws <- 1000
set.seed(2026)

# Locate beta inside the working-parameter vector and take its covariance block
beta_block <- function(m) {
  Sig <- m$mod$Sigma
  if (is.null(Sig)) Sig <- MASS::ginv(m$mod$hessian)
  if (any(!is.finite(Sig))) stop("Covariance matrix has NA/Inf: Hessian not invertible for this fit")
  wpar <- if (!is.null(m$mod$wpar) && length(m$mod$wpar) == nrow(Sig)) m$mod$wpar else m$mod$estimate
  b  <- as.vector(m$mle$beta)
  nb <- length(b)
  hit <- which(vapply(seq_len(length(wpar) - nb + 1), function(st)
    isTRUE(all.equal(unname(wpar[st:(st + nb - 1)]), b, tolerance = 1e-8)), logical(1)))
  if (length(hit) != 1)
    stop("Couldn't locate beta in the working parameters (betaCons/betaRef/mixtures?); set indices manually")
  idx <- hit:(hit + nb - 1)
  list(mu = b, Sigma = Sig[idx, idx], dim = dim(m$mle$beta), dimnames = dimnames(m$mle$beta))
}

draw_betas <- function(fits, B) {
  blocks <- lapply(fits, beta_block)
  pick   <- sample(seq_along(fits), B, replace = TRUE)
  out    <- vector("list", B)
  for (k in seq_along(fits)) {
    ii <- which(pick == k)
    if (length(ii) == 0) next
    bk <- blocks[[k]]
    dr <- matrix(MASS::mvrnorm(length(ii), mu = bk$mu, Sigma = bk$Sigma), nrow = length(ii))
    for (j in seq_along(ii))
      out[[ii[j]]] <- matrix(dr[j, ], bk$dim[1], bk$dim[2], dimnames = bk$dimnames)
  }
  out
}

fits <- list(hmm_model)
beta_draws <- draw_betas(fits, B_draws)
```

```{r effect sizes}
# Effect sizes for a list of periods (first = reference). Point estimate at the MLE,
# 95% percentile intervals across coefficient draws (same draw for every period).
effect_sizes <- function(plist, draws, ref = hist_label) {
  per <- names(plist)
  est <- sapply(plist, period_means, beta = beta_coeffs)                  # states x periods
  arr <- simplify2array(lapply(draws, function(b)                          # states x periods x B
    sapply(plist, period_means, beta = b)))
  dimnames(arr) <- list(behav_levels, per, NULL)

  probs <- expand.grid(Behavior = behav_levels, Period = per, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  probs <- probs %>%
    mutate(Estimate = est[cbind(Behavior, Period)],
           Lower    = mapply(function(b, p) q(arr[b, p, ], .025), Behavior, Period),
           Upper    = mapply(function(b, p) q(arr[b, p, ], .975), Behavior, Period),
           Hours_per_day = 24 * Estimate,
           Period   = factor(Period, levels = period_levels),
           Behavior = factor(Behavior, levels = behav_levels)) %>%
    as_tibble()

  futs  <- setdiff(per, ref)
  pairs <- rbind(cbind(ref = ref, cmp = futs),
                 if (length(futs) > 1) { cb <- t(combn(futs, 2)); cbind(ref = cb[, 1], cmp = cb[, 2]) })

  contrasts <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(pairs)), function(i) {
    r <- pairs[i, "ref"]; cmp <- pairs[i, "cmp"]
    bind_rows(lapply(behav_levels, function(s) {
      d_draw <- 100 * (arr[s, cmp, ] - arr[s, r, ])     # percentage points
      r_draw <- arr[s, cmp, ] / arr[s, r, ]
      tibble(
        Behavior   = s,
        Ref        = r,
        Cmp        = cmp,
        Contrast   = paste(cmp, "vs", r),
        Ref_prob   = est[s, r],
        Cmp_prob   = est[s, cmp],
        Diff_pp    = 100 * (est[s, cmp] - est[s, r]),
        Diff_lo    = q(d_draw, .025),
        Diff_hi    = q(d_draw, .975),
        Diff_h_day = 24 * (est[s, cmp] - est[s, r]),    # same shift in hours/day
        Ratio      = est[s, cmp] / est[s, r],
        Ratio_lo   = q(r_draw, .025),
        Ratio_hi   = q(r_draw, .975),
        P_increase = mean(d_draw > 0)                    # share of draws with an increase
      )
    }))
  })) %>%
    mutate(Behavior = factor(Behavior, levels = behav_levels))

  list(est = est, arr = arr, probs = probs, contrasts = contrasts)
}

es_main <- effect_sizes(period_list, beta_draws)

print(es_main$probs, n = Inf)
es_main$contrasts %>%
  select(-Ref, -Cmp) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3))) %>%
  print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

=======================================
Stationary probabilities across projection horizons
=======================================
Deviation = future winter minus historical, in percentage points, paired over coefficient draws.
```{r winter temp}
set.seed(2026)
B_trend     <- 1000       # coefficient draws used here (subset of beta_draws; raise for the final run)
draws_trend <- beta_draws[seq_len(min(B_trend, length(beta_draws)))]
min_cover   <- 0.95      # drop winters only partly covered by the future files (e.g. 2030/31, 2070/71)
bin_years   <- 5         # winters averaged per point in the table/trend/plot (1 = every winter)

# Winter start year by KST calendar: Oct-Dec -> that year, Jan-Apr -> previous year
winter_of <- function(t) {
  lt <- with_tz(t, "Asia/Seoul")
  year(lt) - as.integer(month(lt) <= 4)
}

# Historical tracking design, re-dated into every future winter
template    <- hist_hangang_data %>% transmute(Station, roundT, W_hist = winter_of(roundT))
fut_winters <- sort(Reduce(intersect, lapply(future_covs_list, function(fc) unique(winter_of(fc$Date_Time)))))
template_all <- bind_rows(lapply(fut_winters, function(W)
  template %>% mutate(Winter = W, match_key = roundT + years(W - W_hist)))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(match_key))                                  # 29 Feb -> non-leap year

# Historical baseline (same as the main analysis) at the MLE and at each draw
hist_est <- period_means(period_list[[hist_label]], beta_coeffs)
hist_arr <- sapply(draws_trend, function(b) period_means(period_list[[hist_label]], b))   # 3 x B

# Per-winter stationary probabilities minus historical, in pp
winter_deviation <- function(fc) {
  d <- template_all %>%
    inner_join(fc %>% mutate(match_key = Date_Time), by = c("match_key", "Station")) %>%
    drop_na(starts_with("Han_"))
  X   <- make_X(d, cov_formula, beta_coeffs)
  g   <- as.integer(interaction(d$Winter, as.Date(d$Date_Time, tz = "Asia/Seoul"),
                                drop = TRUE, lex.order = TRUE))   # winter x KST day
  n_g <- tabulate(g)
  wg  <- d$Winter[match(seq_along(n_g), g)]                    # winter of each day group
  winters <- sort(unique(wg))
  n_w <- tabulate(match(wg, winters))                          # days per winter
  wmeans <- function(b) rowsum(rowsum(stationary_3state(X, b), g) / n_g, wg) / n_w

  cover <- tabulate(match(d$Winter, winters)) / nrow(template)
  keep  <- cover >= min_cover
  est <- 100 * sweep(wmeans(beta_coeffs), 2, hist_est)
  arr <- 100 * sweep(simplify2array(lapply(draws_trend, wmeans)), c(2, 3), hist_arr)
  dimnames(est) <- list(NULL, behav_levels)
  dimnames(arr) <- list(NULL, behav_levels, NULL)
  list(winters = winters[keep], cover = cover[keep],
       est = est[keep, , drop = FALSE], arr = arr[keep, , , drop = FALSE])
}
wt <- lapply(future_covs_list, winter_deviation)   # per winter (also used by the decadal direction plot)

# ---- Average consecutive winters into bins of bin_years ----
# Each winter weighted equally within a bin; draws stay paired.
bin_winters <- function(r, k = bin_years) {
  W     <- r$winters
  start <- min(W) + k * ((W - min(W)) %/% k)
  bins  <- sort(unique(start))
  idx   <- match(start, bins)
  n     <- tabulate(idx)
  nb    <- length(bins); B <- dim(r$arr)[3]
  last  <- as.vector(tapply(W, idx, max))
  est   <- rowsum(r$est, idx) / n
  arr   <- array(rowsum(matrix(r$arr, nrow = length(W)), idx) / n, dim = c(nb, length(behav_levels), B))
  dimnames(est) <- list(NULL, behav_levels)
  dimnames(arr) <- list(NULL, behav_levels, NULL)
  list(winters   = as.vector(tapply(W, idx, mean)),          # bin midpoint (x position)
       label     = if (k == 1) as.character(bins) else paste0(bins, "-", last),
       n_winters = n,
       cover     = as.vector(tapply(r$cover, idx, mean)),
       est = est, arr = arr)
}
wt_plot <- lapply(wt, bin_winters)

# ---- Per-bin table ----
wt_tab <- bind_rows(lapply(scenarios, function(s) {
  r <- wt_plot[[s]]
  bind_rows(lapply(behav_levels, function(b) {
    dm <- matrix(r$arr[, b, ], nrow = length(r$winters))     # change vs historical (pp), bins x draws
    ab <- sweep(dm / 100, 2, hist_arr[b, ], "+")              # absolute probability, bins x draws
    tibble(Scenario = s, Behavior = b, Winter = r$winters, Label = r$label, N_winters = r$n_winters,
           Coverage = r$cover,
           Diff_pp  = r$est[, b],
           Lo       = apply(dm, 1, q, .025),
           Hi       = apply(dm, 1, q, .975),
           Estimate = hist_est[[b]] + r$est[, b] / 100,
           Lower    = apply(ab, 1, q, .025),
           Upper    = apply(ab, 1, q, .975))
  }))
})) %>%
  mutate(Scenario = factor(Scenario, levels = scenarios),
         Behavior = factor(Behavior, levels = behav_levels))

# ---- pp per decade and mean deviation over all future winters ----
ols <- function(x, y) {
  xc <- x - mean(x); b <- sum(xc * y) / sum(xc^2)
  r  <- y - mean(y) - b * xc
  c(slope = b, se = sqrt(sum(r^2) / (length(x) - 2) / sum(xc^2)))
}
trend_tab <- bind_rows(lapply(scenarios, function(s) bind_rows(lapply(behav_levels, function(b) {
  r  <- wt_plot[[s]]; x <- r$winters
  sl <- apply(r$arr[, b, ], 2, function(y) { f <- ols(x, y); f[["slope"]] + rnorm(1, 0, f[["se"]]) })
  md <- colMeans(r$arr[, b, ])
  tibble(Scenario        = s,
         Behavior        = factor(b, levels = behav_levels),
         Winters         = paste0(r$label[1], " ... ", tail(r$label, 1), " (", length(x), " points)"),
         Mean_dev_pp     = mean(r$est[, b]),
         Mean_lo         = q(md, .025),
         Mean_hi         = q(md, .975),
         Between_winter_SD = sd(r$est[, b]),
         Slope_pp_decade = 10 * ols(x, r$est[, b])[["slope"]],
         Slope_lo        = 10 * q(sl, .025),
         Slope_hi        = 10 * q(sl, .975),
         P_slope_pos     = mean(sl > 0))
}))))
trend_tab %>% arrange(Behavior, Scenario) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3))) %>% print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
```
Against the observed historical baseline (Traveling 0.121, Foraging 0.438, Roosting 0.441):

- Traveling: +0.8 to +1.2 pp, roughly +11 to 17 min/day, or about 7–10% more than the baseline of 12%. The increase is smallest under SSP2-4.5 (+0.80 pp); SSP1-2.6 and SSP5-8.5 are almost equal (+1.20 and +1.19 pp).
- Roosting: −1.1 to −1.6 pp, roughly −16 to 23 min/day, about 2.4–3.6% less than the baseline of 44%. The decrease is largest under SSP5-8.5 (−1.59 pp, about −23 min/day).
- Foraging: essentially unchanged, between −0.1 and +0.4 pp, roughly −2 to +6 min/day, which is less than 1% of the baseline of 44%.
shift from roosting toward traveling

```{r winter trend, fig.width=9, fig.height=3.8}
# ---- Figure 1: stationary probability per bin, all SSPs vs historical ----
# Historical point/interval from the same draws as the future bins
hist_pt <- tibble(Period   = factor(hist_label, levels = period_levels),
                  Behavior = factor(behav_levels, levels = behav_levels),
                  Estimate = unname(hist_est),
                  Lower    = apply(hist_arr, 1, q, .025),

hist_mid <- mean(hist_years)
lb       <- distinct(wt_tab, Winter, Label) %>% arrange(Winter)
thin_x   <- if (nrow(lb) > 12) seq(1, nrow(lb), by = 5) else seq_len(nrow(lb))   # fewer labels per winter

plot_winter <- ggplot(wt_tab %>% mutate(Period = factor(Scenario, levels = period_levels)),
                      aes(x = Winter, y = Estimate, colour = Period)) +
  geom_hline(data = hist_pt, aes(yintercept = Estimate), linetype = 2, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper, fill = Period, group = Period),
              alpha = 0.12, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = if (bin_years == 1) 1 else 1.8) +
  geom_pointrange(data = hist_pt,
                  aes(x = hist_mid, y = Estimate, ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper, colour = Period),
                  inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ Behavior, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = period_col, breaks = period_levels) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = period_fill, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(hist_mid, lb$Winter[thin_x]),
                     labels = c(paste0(hist_years[1], "-", hist_years[2]), lb$Label[thin_x])) +
  labs(y = "Stationary probability", colour = NULL,
       caption = paste0("Lines/points = MLE ",
                        if (bin_years == 1) "per winter" else paste0("per ", bin_years, "-winter mean"),
                        "; ribbons and bars = 95% interval over ", length(draws_trend),
                        " coefficient draws. Dashed = historical baseline.\n",
                        "Historical tracking design applied to every future winter. ",
                        "Draws are paired, so test differences with Diff_pp/Lo/Hi in wt_tab, not ribbon overlap.")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7, angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

==========================
Simulate Future Sequences
==========================
```{r}
set.seed(2026)
B_seq      <- 500    # coefficient draws
min_steps  <- 200    # skip historical winters with fewer Hangang steps
sim_levels <- c(hist_label, scenarios)
#metric_names <- c("Bouts per day | Foraging", "Mean bout (h) | Foraging", "Mean gap between foraging (h)")
metric_names <- c(paste("Bouts per day |", behav_levels),
                  paste("Mean bout (h) |", behav_levels),
                  paste0("Mean gap between ", tolower(behav_levels), " (h)"))

# Continuous 1-h segments per bird (a new segment at every gap or change of bird)
make_seg <- function(id, t) {
  tt <- as.numeric(t)
  cumsum(c(TRUE, id[-1] != id[-length(id)] | diff(tt) != 3600))
}

hrows <- hist_hangang_data %>%
  mutate(row = row_number(), W_hist = winter_of(roundT)) %>%
  arrange(ID, roundT) %>%
  select(row, ID, Station, roundT, W_hist)
hist_w <- split(hrows, hrows$W_hist)
hist_w <- hist_w[vapply(hist_w, nrow, integer(1)) >= min_steps]
fut_winters_ok <- wt[[scenarios[1]]]$winters     # all future winters (2031-2069 starts)
fc_by_winter   <- lapply(future_covs_list, function(fc) split(fc, winter_of(fc$Date_Time)))

X_obs <- make_X(hist_hangang_data, hmm_model$conditions$formula, beta_coeffs)

# Markov chain with time-varying TPM; the transition into step t uses the covariates at t-1
# (a one-step offset has negligible effect at 1-h steps). Each segment starts from the
# stationary distribution at its first step. States: 1 Traveling, 2 Foraging, 3 Roosting.
sim_states <- function(X, beta, seg, u) {
  e  <- exp(X %*% beta)
  s1 <- 1 + e[, 1] + e[, 2]; s2 <- 1 + e[, 3] + e[, 4]; s3 <- 1 + e[, 5] + e[, 6]
  C  <- list(cbind(1 / s1,      (1 + e[, 1]) / s1),         # cumulative P(->1), P(->1 or 2) from 1
             cbind(e[, 3] / s2, (e[, 3] + 1) / s2),         # from 2
             cbind(e[, 5] / s3, (e[, 5] + e[, 6]) / s3))    # from 3
  n     <- nrow(X)
  start <- c(TRUE, seg[-1] != seg[-n])
  P0    <- matrix(NA_real_, n, 3)
  P0[start, ] <- stationary_3state(X[start, , drop = FALSE], beta)
  st <- integer(n)
  for (t in seq_len(n)) {
    cp    <- if (start[t]) c(P0[t, 1], P0[t, 1] + P0[t, 2]) else C[[st[t - 1]]][t - 1, ]
    st[t] <- 1L + (u[t] > cp[1]) + (u[t] > cp[2])
  }
  st
}

# Bout metrics per state. Bout and gap lengths use complete runs only (not cut by a segment edge).
#seq_metrics <- function(st, seg) {
#  n     <- length(st)
#  same  <- c(FALSE, seg[-1] == seg[-n])               # step continues the previous step's segment
#  f     <- st == 2L
#  id    <- cumsum(!same | c(TRUE, f[-1] != f[-n]))    # runs of foraging / not foraging
#  len   <- tabulate(id)
#  first <- match(seq_along(len), id); last <- first + len - 1
#  value    <- f[first]
#  complete <- same[first] & c(same[-1], FALSE)[last]
#  bouts <- len[value & complete]
#  gaps  <- len[!value & complete]
#  setNames(c(sum(same & f & !c(FALSE, f[-n])) / n * 24,
#             if (length(bouts)) mean(bouts) else NA_real_,
#             if (length(gaps))  mean(gaps)  else NA_real_), metric_names)
#}
seq_metrics <- function(st, seg) {
  n    <- length(st)
  same <- c(FALSE, seg[-1] == seg[-n])                # step continues the previous step's segment
  prev <- c(0L, st[-n])
  sw   <- same & st != prev                           # switch into st at this step
  runs <- function(x) {                               # complete runs of x: values and lengths
    id    <- cumsum(!same | c(TRUE, x[-1] != x[-n]))
    len   <- tabulate(id)
    first <- match(seq_along(len), id); last <- first + len - 1
    keep  <- same[first] & c(same[-1], FALSE)[last]
    list(value = x[first][keep], len = len[keep])
  }
  r <- runs(st)
  mbout <- function(k) { x <- r$len[r$value == k]; if (length(x)) mean(x) else NA_real_ }
  # gap = complete run of steps NOT in state k, between two bouts of k
  mgap  <- function(k) { g <- runs(st == k); x <- g$len[!g$value]; if (length(x)) mean(x) else NA_real_ }
  setNames(c(sapply(1:3, function(k) sum(sw & st == k)) / n * 24,
             sapply(1:3, mbout),
             sapply(1:3, mgap)), metric_names)
}

# spread across draws reflects parameter uncertainty
h_order <- rep_len(sample(length(hist_w)), length(fut_winters_ok))
design  <- lapply(seq_along(fut_winters_ok), function(j) {
  h  <- hist_w[[h_order[j]]]
  Wf <- fut_winters_ok[j]
  keys <- h %>% transmute(row, Station, match_key = roundT + years(Wf - W_hist))
  fut_rows <- lapply(scenarios, function(s)
    keys %>%
      left_join(fc_by_winter[[s]][[as.character(Wf)]] %>% mutate(match_key = Date_Time),
                by = c("match_key", "Station")) %>%
      distinct(row, .keep_all = TRUE))
  ok <- Reduce(`&`, lapply(fut_rows, function(d)
    complete.cases(d[, c("Date_Time", grep("^Han_", names(d), value = TRUE))])))
  hk <- h[ok, ]
  list(seg = make_seg(hk$ID, hk$roundT),                           # re-segment after dropped steps
       u   = runif(nrow(hk)),                                      # common random numbers
       X   = c(setNames(list(X_obs[hk$row, , drop = FALSE]), hist_label),
               setNames(lapply(fut_rows, function(d) make_X(d[ok, ], cov_formula, beta_coeffs)), scenarios)))
})

# ---- Simulate every winter under each coefficient draw ----
draws_seq <- beta_draws[seq_len(min(B_seq, length(beta_draws)))]
sim_arr <- array(NA_real_, dim = c(length(metric_names), length(sim_levels), length(design), length(draws_seq)),
                 dimnames = list(metric_names, sim_levels, NULL, NULL))   # metric x period x winter x draw
for (k in seq_along(draws_seq)) {
  b <- draws_seq[[k]]
  for (j in seq_along(design)) {
    d <- design[[j]]
    sim_arr[, , j, k] <- sapply(sim_levels, function(p) seq_metrics(sim_states(d$X[[p]], b, d$seg, d$u), d$seg))
  }
}

# Per-draw means over the design winters (metric x period x draw)
draw_means <- apply(sim_arr, c(1, 2, 4), mean, na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Mean of each metric per period
seq_means <- apply(draw_means, c(1, 2), mean)
as_tibble(seq_means, rownames = "Metric") %>%
  mutate(Metric = factor(Metric, levels = metric_names),
         across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3))) %>%
  print(n = Inf, width = Inf)

# SSP - historical, paired within each coefficient draw.
# Diff_lo/Diff_hi = 95% interval across draws (parameter uncertainty of the mean effect);
# P_increase = share of draws in which the SSP mean is higher than historical.
# Metrics shown in the contrast table (bout frequency, bout length and gap length per state)
table_metrics <- metric_names

seq_contrasts <- bind_rows(lapply(scenarios, function(s) bind_rows(lapply(table_metrics, function(mt) {
  dd <- draw_means[mt, s, ] - draw_means[mt, hist_label, ]
  tibble(Metric     = factor(mt, levels = table_metrics),
         Contrast   = paste(s, "- historical"),
         Mean_diff  = mean(dd),
         Diff_lo    = q(dd, .025),
         Diff_hi    = q(dd, .975),
         Rel_change = mean(dd) / seq_means[mt, hist_label])
})))) %>% arrange(Metric)
seq_contrasts %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3))) %>% print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

```{r trajectory simulation}
set.seed(010)
# Historical tracking winter with the most steps, and the bird with the most steps in it.
# Future climate = the same dates `horizon` years later.
traj_W_hist <- as.integer(names(which.max(vapply(hist_w, nrow, integer(1)))))
traj_W_fut  <- traj_W_hist + horizon
stopifnot("traj_W_fut is outside the future covariates" = traj_W_fut %in% fut_winters_ok)

h <- hist_w[[as.character(traj_W_hist)]]
traj_id <- names(which.max(table(as.character(h$ID))))
h <- h %>% filter(as.character(ID) == traj_id)                    # already ordered by time

# Future covariates at the matched dates; usable steps = complete in every scenario
keys <- h %>% transmute(row, Station, match_key = roundT + years(traj_W_fut - W_hist))
fut_rows <- lapply(scenarios, function(s)
  keys %>%
    left_join(fc_by_winter[[s]][[as.character(traj_W_fut)]] %>% mutate(match_key = Date_Time),
              by = c("match_key", "Station")) %>%
    distinct(row, .keep_all = TRUE))
ok <- Reduce(`&`, lapply(fut_rows, function(d)
  complete.cases(d[, c("Date_Time", grep("^Han_", names(d), value = TRUE))])))

# Keep only the longest unbroken run of hourly usable steps
ok_idx    <- which(ok)
seg_ok    <- make_seg(h$ID[ok_idx], h$roundT[ok_idx])             # new segment at every gap
seg_len   <- tabulate(seg_ok)
sel       <- ok_idx[seg_ok == which.max(seg_len)]                 # rows of h in the longest segment
stopifnot(all(diff(as.numeric(h$roundT[sel])) == 3600))

traj_start <- with_tz(min(h$roundT[sel]), "Asia/Seoul")
traj_end   <- with_tz(max(h$roundT[sel]), "Asia/Seoul")
traj_steps <- length(sel)

# Covariates for simData: only the variables in the HMM formula
fvars <- all.vars(hmm_model$conditions$formula)
traj_covs <- c(setNames(list(hist_hangang_data[h$row[sel], fvars, drop = FALSE]), hist_label),
               setNames(lapply(fut_rows, function(d) d[sel, fvars, drop = FALSE]), scenarios))
stopifnot(!anyNA(bind_rows(traj_covs)))
message("Bird ", traj_id, ": winter ", traj_W_hist, "/", traj_W_hist + 1, " tracking, ",
        traj_W_fut, "/", traj_W_fut + 1, " climate; longest continuous segment of ",
        length(seg_len), ": ", format(traj_start, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), " to ",
        format(traj_end, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"), " KST, ", traj_steps, " steps (",
        round(traj_steps / 24, 1), " days)")

# Simulate one continuous track per period (MLE parameters)
traj_sim <- bind_rows(lapply(period_levels, function(p)
  simData(model = hmm_model, covs = traj_covs[[p]], obsPerAnimal = nrow(traj_covs[[p]]), states = TRUE) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    transmute(x, y, Behavior = factor(behav_levels[states], levels = behav_levels), Period = p))) %>%
  mutate(Period = factor(Period, levels = period_levels))
```

=======================================
Sensitivity check: cubic interpolation vs native resolution
=======================================
Native = daily Temp/Wind/water quality held constant over the day, and month SPI6.
```{r interp sensitivity 1}
native_files <- setNames(sub("30min", "native_daily", ssp_files), scenarios)
stopifnot(all(file.exists(native_files)))

prep_native_covs <- function(path) {
  read.csv(path) %>%
    mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) %>%
    arrange(Station, Date) %>%
    # SPI6 is monthly and stored on the 1st of each month only:
    # give every day of the month that month's value (step function over the month)
    group_by(Station, Month = floor_date(Date, "month")) %>%
    fill(SPI6, .direction = "downup") %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    { stopifnot("SPI6 still missing after fill" = !anyNA(.$SPI6)); . } %>%
    filter(month(Date) %in% c(10, 11, 12, 1, 2, 3, 4)) %>%
    # daily values held constant over the 48 half-hours of each KST day (step function over the day)
    crossing(slot = 0:47) %>%
    mutate(Date_Time  = with_tz(force_tz(as.POSIXct(Date), "Asia/Seoul") + slot * 1800, "UTC"),
           In_Hangang = 1,
           Han_Temp   = z_ref(Temperature.C.,   "Temp"),
           Han_Wind   = z_ref(Wind_Speed.m.s.,  "Wind"),
           Han_SPI6   = z_ref(SPI6,             "SPI6"),   # native monthly SPI6
           Han_wTemp  = z_ref(Pred_Water_Temp,  "wTemp"),
           Han_BOD    = z_ref(Pred_BOD,         "BOD"),
           Han_DTN    = z_ref(Pred_DTN,         "DTN"),
           Han_Chlor  = z_ref(Pred_Chlorophyll, "Chlor")) %>%
    select(Station, Date_Time, In_Hangang, starts_with("Han_")) %>%
    na.omit() %>%
    distinct(Station, Date_Time, .keep_all = TRUE)
}
native_covs_list <- lapply(native_files, prep_native_covs)
```

```{r}
## ---- A. Step-level stationary probabilities: interpolated vs native, same transferred steps ----
has_covs <- function(d) complete.cases(d[, c("Date_Time", grep("^Han_", names(d), value = TRUE))])

# Every historical step transferred into every retained future winter
trans_all <- bind_rows(lapply(sort(unique(unlist(lapply(wt[scenarios], `[[`, "winters")))), function(Wf)
  hrows %>% transmute(row, Station, W = Wf, match_key = roundT + years(Wf - W_hist)))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(match_key))                                          # 29 Feb in non-leap target years

join_covs <- function(keys, fc) keys %>%
  left_join(fc %>% distinct(Station, Date_Time, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% mutate(match_key = Date_Time),
            by = c("Station", "match_key"))

# Stationary probabilities at the MLE, per transferred step, under both covariate versions
sens_prob_tab <- bind_rows(lapply(scenarios, function(s) {
  tr    <- trans_all %>% filter(W %in% wt[[s]]$winters)
  keys  <- tr %>% distinct(Station, match_key) %>% mutate(k = row_number())
  d_int <- join_covs(keys, future_covs_list[[s]])
  d_nat <- join_covs(keys, native_covs_list[[s]])
  ok_int <- has_covs(d_int); ok_nat <- has_covs(d_nat)
  tr <- tr %>% left_join(keys, by = c("Station", "match_key")) %>% filter(ok_int[k])
  stopifnot("steps without native covariates" = all(ok_nat[tr$k]))   # same step set as the main analysis
  kk <- which(ok_int & ok_nat)
  idx <- match(tr$k, kk)                                              # step -> unique future timestamp
  Pi <- stationary_3state(make_X(d_int[kk, ], cov_formula, beta_coeffs), beta_coeffs)[idx, , drop = FALSE]
  Pn <- stationary_3state(make_X(d_nat[kk, ], cov_formula, beta_coeffs), beta_coeffs)[idx, , drop = FALSE]
  colnames(Pi) <- colnames(Pn) <- behav_levels
  bind_rows(lapply(behav_levels, function(bh) { x <- Pi[, bh]; y <- Pn[, bh]
    tibble(Scenario = s, Behavior = bh, N_steps = length(x), Mean_interp = mean(x), Mean_native = mean(y),
           Diff = mean(y) - mean(x), MAE_step = mean(abs(x - y)), RMSE_step = sqrt(mean((x - y)^2)),
           r = cor(x, y))
  }))
}))
print(sens_prob_tab, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
 ## ---- B. Simulated bout metrics: interpolated vs native ----
has_covs <- function(d) complete.cases(d[, c("Date_Time", grep("^Han_", names(d), value = TRUE))])
nat_by_winter <- lapply(native_covs_list, function(fc) split(fc, winter_of(fc$Date_Time)))
get_w <- function(lst, Wf) { x <- lst[[as.character(Wf)]]; if (is.null(x)) lst[[1]][0, ] else x }

design_sens <- lapply(seq_along(fut_winters_ok), function(j) {
  h  <- hist_w[[h_order[j]]]
  Wf <- fut_winters_ok[j]
  keys <- h %>% transmute(row, Station, match_key = roundT + years(Wf - W_hist))
  join_w <- function(fc_w) keys %>%
    left_join(fc_w %>% mutate(match_key = Date_Time), by = c("match_key", "Station")) %>%
    distinct(row, .keep_all = TRUE)
  int_rows <- lapply(scenarios, function(s) join_w(get_w(fc_by_winter[[s]], Wf)))
  nat_rows <- lapply(scenarios, function(s) join_w(get_w(nat_by_winter[[s]], Wf)))
  ok_int <- Reduce(`&`, lapply(int_rows, has_covs))           # = the main design's steps
  ok_nat <- Reduce(`&`, lapply(nat_rows, has_covs))
  stopifnot(sum(ok_int) == length(design[[j]]$u))
  ok <- ok_int & ok_nat
  hk <- h[ok, ]
  mk <- function(rows) lapply(rows, function(d) make_X(d[ok, ], cov_formula, beta_coeffs))
  list(seg       = make_seg(hk$ID, hk$roundT),
       u         = design[[j]]$u[ok[ok_int]],                 # same random numbers as the main run
       n_dropped = sum(ok_int & !ok_nat),
       X = c(setNames(list(X_obs[hk$row, , drop = FALSE]), hist_label),
             setNames(mk(int_rows), paste(scenarios, "| int")),
             setNames(mk(nat_rows), paste(scenarios, "| nat"))))
})
n_drop <- sapply(design_sens, `[[`, "n_dropped")
cat("Main-design steps without native covariates:", sum(n_drop), "\n")

sens_levels <- names(design_sens[[1]]$X)
sens_arr <- array(NA_real_, dim = c(length(metric_names), length(sens_levels), length(design_sens), length(draws_seq)),
                  dimnames = list(metric_names, sens_levels, NULL, NULL))
for (k in seq_along(draws_seq)) {
  b <- draws_seq[[k]]
  for (j in seq_along(design_sens)) {
    d <- design_sens[[j]]
    sens_arr[, , j, k] <- sapply(sens_levels, function(p) seq_metrics(sim_states(d$X[[p]], b, d$seg, d$u), d$seg))
  }
}
sens_draw_means <- apply(sens_arr, c(1, 2, 4), mean, na.rm = TRUE)

# TRUE = the interpolated side reproduces the main simulation (only when no steps were dropped)
if (all(n_drop == 0))
  print(all.equal(unname(sens_draw_means[, c(hist_label, paste(scenarios, "| int")), ]), unname(draw_means)))

# SSP - historical contrast under each covariate version (mean over draws), and native - interpolated
# Bouts per day, mean bout and mean gap between bouts, for each state
cmp_metrics <- metric_names
seq_cmp <- bind_rows(lapply(scenarios, function(s) bind_rows(lapply(cmp_metrics, function(mt) {
  h  <- sens_draw_means[mt, hist_label, ]
  di <- sens_draw_means[mt, paste(s, "| int"), ] - h
  dn <- sens_draw_means[mt, paste(s, "| nat"), ] - h
  tibble(Metric        = factor(mt, levels = cmp_metrics),
         Contrast      = paste(s, "- historical"),
         Diff_int      = mean(di),
         Diff_nat      = mean(dn),
         Nat_minus_int = mean(dn - di))
})))) %>% arrange(Metric)
seq_cmp %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3))) %>% print(n = Inf, width = Inf)
```
